purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The Tai’an Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau’s official unit directory describes the municipal Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center as responsible for unified registration across the Tai’an urban districts, including cadastral-rights investigation, city registration, transaction management and registration-information queries. This directly covers the Tai’an urban core. Official bureau pages describe cadastral-map visualization/search functions, but the reviewed workflow is exposed through the one-network registration platform, Shandong government portal, or an identity-verified self-service terminal using unit/parcel code or location. These flows can return registration attributes beyond safe geometry and identifier fields. No form or feature query was submitted; no anonymous server-side allowlist or parcel geometry schema was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Tai’an bureau unit directory: the municipal registration/transaction center handles cadastral investigations and unified registration in Tai’an urban districts, including Taishan and Daiyue.
Official Tai’an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau homepage and public service portal.

Official bureau report describes cadastral-map visual queries in the one-network platform and authenticated self-service terminal, with lookup keyed by property-unit/parcel code or location and registration attributes returned.

Official report states the center’s online service channel includes cadastral-map queries, alongside registration certificates, progress and payment services; this is not a documented geometry-only endpoint.
